scope: (a) the super_dome fps question, settled with RENDER's agreed method (tools/render_perf.mjs, presets tools/perf/*, 10 s settle, 30 s sampling, no capture, vsync, CPU load recorded); (b) in-game ratings from art/critic_input/render/154_v5_dome_glass_s9_arcade.png, 155_v5_civic_buildings_floors.png, 156_v5_photo_tabloid_portraits.png. Build build/web_render (index.pck 102.7 MB, 2026-09-30 20:43).

fps.method: node tools/render_perf.mjs --dir build/web_render --query "title=0&debug=1&seed=1001" --pre tools/perf/<case>.json --secs 30 --settle 10 --vsync; outputs in art/critic/critic_r39/critic_perf_*.json
fps.verdict: SETTLED in RENDER's favour for the budget: at low PC load (10-20 % CPU) every case meets >= 45 fps (mean 52.7-59.8, median 59.9). My round-34 33 fps was the method (one sample after a screenshot, a few seconds after a camera jump) plus other agents' load. One caveat stays on record: dome_v3 follow (66 people, dust storm) dropped to median 30 / mean 37.6 with 6 frames over 50 ms at 31 % CPU load; on a player's PC with background load this case sits close to the edge. SIM agents 3.4 ms and view 9 ms per frame in that run. No score cap applied.

verified: Glass: fresnel glass reads as glass by day (sky reflection at the rim) and as a warm-rimmed shell by night (154).
Night 250 m: the ring glows with multicoloured windows and neon under the lit shell; the brightest thing in the colony. Paul's 'glittering city under glass' is met at the colony camera.
Dust storm by night: windows and signs stay bright through the storm grade (154, last tile).
PRISM SHIFT: the attract loop shows the prism ship over the neon hexagon tunnel.

carry_over_fixes_not_blocking.fix: POI labels (RICH DEPOSIT, METEORITE FIELD) still draw through the walls into the arcade (154).
Club door: bouncer post and ADULTS ONLY sign in view (round 32).

civic_modules.verified: In game (155): retail, park, academy, security office and jail read by silhouette and badge outside; the cutaways show furnished floors; the night group reads by badges. Floor hiding works on the apartment block (floors 1/2/3 viewed, upper floors, wall tops and roof hidden).

carry_over_fixes_not_blocking.fix: Retail L and academy M empty floor patches (round 37).

residences.verified: Apartment block in game: stepped exterior, floor-by-floor cutaway with furnished units round the core and the penthouse terrace (155). Residence tubes Family and Executive outside and cut away, variant lookup correct.
residences.why_not_final: The follow view inside the tube (the one in-game close view of a home) fails: one tile is almost entirely black (camera behind or under geometry, only the sky visible), the other shows the person as a black silhouette against a bright appliance with no interior light on the face (155, last two tiles). The rubric asks for the follow view in a family unit and a penthouse.

fixes.fix: Follow view inside a tube unit: keep the camera inside the unit's walls (pull-in), light the followed person with the room lights, and supply one family-unit and one penthouse follow shot.

regolith_rag.photo_check: photo() works: named people, place backdrop, pose hint, paparazzi grain, 512x384, portraits (156). With the v3 stand-ins it reads as a placeholder: flat single-colour backdrops; hug and argue fall back to idle (two people standing apart); every indoor face shows a grey breathing-mask shape over the mouth; the club/cheer photo includes a suited astronaut in a club (outfit rule).

fixes.fix: Paired poses in photos once the MPFB people land (hug, argue, handcuffed escort must show the pair in contact).
Backdrops: use the real 3D spot or a set with depth (bar counter, park bench and trees, cell bars) instead of a flat wall and one prop.
Indoor faces must not show the suit breathing mask; club photos must not include suited people.
